source: docs/09-exceptions.md (one entry per code, English screen text, 11-ui 1.7)

ZL-CTL-001.fix: Use the window that is already open.

ZL-CTL-002.what: The test keeps running in the background
ZL-CTL-002.why: The window was closed; the test runs in the service.

ZL-CTL-003.why: The service stopped (crash or forced restart) during a test.
ZL-CTL-003.fix: Nothing needed: devices were stopped and a recovery report was made. Check the report.

ZL-CTL-004.what: Controller PC sleep or update restart
ZL-CTL-004.why: Sleep or an update restart would stop the service.
ZL-CTL-004.fix: Nothing needed during a test: they are blocked and restored after.

ZL-CTL-005.why: A heavy task was about to run on the screen thread.
ZL-CTL-005.fix: Send the logs (this is a ZeroLoss fault).

ZL-CTL-006.why: Another program uses port 10993; tests still work.
ZL-CTL-006.fix: Nothing to do for the test. ZeroLoss opens the page by itself as soon as the port is free (it tries every 30 s); close the other program to free it sooner.

ZL-CTL-008.why: An agent lost its Controller and stopped sending and receiving.
ZL-CTL-008.fix: Start the Controller again; stop leftovers from the agent's window if needed.

ZL-CTL-009.why: The screen app ended or hung and was started again.

ZL-DSC-001.why: No ZeroLoss node answered the scan.
ZL-DSC-001.fix: Check cables, power and the firewall, or add the device by IP.

ZL-DSC-002.what: Two agents have the same name
ZL-DSC-002.why: Two PCs use the same device name.
ZL-DSC-002.fix: Pick the right one by its IP address, then rename the other.

ZL-DSC-003.what: Agent is paired with another Controller
ZL-DSC-003.why: This agent already works for a different Controller.
ZL-DSC-003.fix: Take over the agent only if the other Controller is no longer used.

ZL-DSC-004.why: The device got a new address (DHCP renewal).
ZL-DSC-004.fix: Nothing to do: the same device was found again by its ID.

ZL-DSC-005.why: This PC got a new address.
ZL-DSC-005.fix: Nothing to do: the agents' allowed address was updated.

ZL-DSC-006.what: Unclear which network card faces the router
ZL-DSC-006.why: The PC has more than one network card.
ZL-DSC-006.fix: Pick the card connected to the router under test.

ZL-DSC-007.what: Router mode differs from the one chosen
ZL-DSC-007.why: The NAT check found another mode than the one set.
ZL-DSC-007.fix: Check the router's mode, or change the setting to match.

ZL-DSC-008.why: The OS firewall rule for ZeroLoss is missing.
ZL-DSC-008.fix: Press Repair to restore the firewall rule.

ZL-DSC-009.what: Device clocks differ by more than 2 s
ZL-DSC-009.why: A device's clock is far from the Controller's.
ZL-DSC-009.fix: Nothing needed for results (times are corrected); set the clock if you want exact local times.

ZL-DSC-010.fix: Enter the sender PC's IP by hand (shown under My IP on that PC).

ZL-DSC-011.why: It was sent before a reset or restart.
ZL-DSC-011.fix: Nothing to do: send the command again if still needed.

ZL-DSC-012.why: The request was not valid JSON or missed a required field.
ZL-DSC-012.fix: Check the details, then send a corrected request.

ZL-DSC-013.why: One device was updated and another was not.
ZL-DSC-013.fix: Update the device shown to the same build.

ZL-DSC-014.why: The connection was refused, timed out or dropped.
ZL-DSC-014.fix: Check that the PC is on, the cable is in and the ZeroLoss service is running.

ZL-DSC-016.what: Another PC answers at a device's address
ZL-DSC-016.why: The address saved for this device belongs to a different PC (another device ID answers there).
ZL-DSC-016.fix: Pick or type the address this PC shows under My IP in its row (IP).

ZL-DSC-015.what: The Controller's test network card carries its default route
ZL-DSC-015.why: Not used: this case is reported as NET-019, which also offers the fix.

ZL-INS-001.why: The installer changes services, firewall rules and program folders.
ZL-INS-001.fix: Run the installer as administrator (Windows) or with sudo (Linux).

ZL-INS-002.what: Not enough disk space to install
ZL-INS-002.why: The install needs more free space than this PC has.
ZL-INS-002.fix: Free up disk space, then run the installer again.

ZL-INS-003.what: A ZeroLoss port is already in use
ZL-INS-003.fix: Close the program shown, or change it to another port, then install again.

ZL-INS-004.why: Security software often flags packed programs by mistake.
ZL-INS-004.fix: Add the ZeroLoss folder to the antivirus exceptions, then install again.

ZL-INS-005.what: This OS or CPU is not supported
ZL-INS-005.why: ZeroLoss runs on the listed Windows and Linux versions on x86-64.
ZL-INS-005.fix: Use a PC from the supported list.

ZL-INS-006.why: A file is missing or its checksum does not match.

ZL-INS-007.why: The user name or password was not accepted.
ZL-INS-007.fix: Check the account and password, then try again.

ZL-INS-008.why: The Linux PC does not allow password login as root.
ZL-INS-008.fix: Use an account that can run sudo.

ZL-INS-009.why: The Linux PC answers with a different key than before (reinstalled, or another PC).
ZL-INS-009.fix: Check that it is the right PC, then confirm the new key.

ZL-INS-010.what: sudo asks for a password in a terminal only
ZL-INS-010.why: The Linux PC requires a terminal for the sudo password.
ZL-INS-010.fix: ZeroLoss retries by passing the password; if it still fails, allow sudo for this account.

ZL-INS-011.why: Automatic updates are using apt right now.
ZL-INS-011.fix: Wait; ZeroLoss retries every 30 s for up to 10 min. Press Cancel to stop waiting.

ZL-INS-012.what: No offline package for this OS version
ZL-INS-012.why: The offline bundle has no tools for this Linux or Windows version.
ZL-INS-012.fix: Get the bundle shown for this OS version, or allow an online install.

ZL-INS-013.why: The PC lost power or was shut down during the upgrade.
ZL-INS-013.fix: Nothing to do: the previous version was restored. Run the upgrade again when ready.

ZL-INS-014.why: The deployer on port 10991 did not respond after 3 tries.
ZL-INS-014.fix: Windows: reinstall on that PC. Linux: run the SSH repair install.

ZL-INS-015.why: Parts of the system were updated separately.
ZL-INS-015.fix: Update the devices listed, then start the test.

ZL-INS-016.why: An older app with another signature is installed.
ZL-INS-016.fix: Remove the old app first (its data will be deleted), then install again.

ZL-INS-017.why: The app needs more free space on the tablet.
ZL-INS-017.fix: Free up space on the tablet, then install again.

ZL-INS-018.what: Tablet asks to allow the install
ZL-INS-018.why: Some tablets show a confirmation before installing apps.
ZL-INS-018.fix: Tap Allow on the tablet within 2 minutes.

ZL-INS-019.why: The tablet has not trusted this PC yet.
ZL-INS-019.fix: Tap Allow USB debugging on the tablet.

ZL-INS-020.what: A file is in use and cannot be removed
ZL-INS-020.why: A running program still holds the file.
ZL-INS-020.fix: ZeroLoss retries after stopping it; if it stays, restart the PC to finish removal.

ZL-INS-021.why: Some installed items could not be removed.
ZL-INS-021.fix: Remove the listed items by hand, as shown.

ZL-INS-022.why: Installing now would change the devices under test.

ZL-INS-023.why: The install stopped before it finished.
ZL-INS-023.fix: Nothing to do: what was installed so far was removed. Run the installer again when ready.

ZL-INS-024.why: Its module.json is missing or broken, it needs another Core version, or it failed to load.
ZL-INS-024.fix: Update or reinstall that module in Modules.

ZL-INS-025.what: Settings or database format cannot be used
ZL-INS-025.why: The file was written by another build (newer, or conversion failed).
ZL-INS-025.fix: Update ZeroLoss to the build shown; the previous copy was kept.

ZL-INS-026.what: A newer build is already installed
ZL-INS-026.why: The package is older than what the device has; downgrades are refused.
ZL-INS-026.fix: Send the same or a newer build.

ZL-INS-027.why: The device installs one package at a time.
ZL-INS-027.fix: Wait until it finishes, then try again.

ZL-INS-028.why: The package manager (dpkg/apt) reported an error.
ZL-INS-028.fix: Read the last line shown, fix the cause on that PC, then install again.

ZL-INS-029.what: A tool this test needs is not installed
ZL-INS-029.why: The device does not have a program the test uses (for example tsp or VLC).
ZL-INS-029.fix: Install the tool on that PC, then press Start again.

ZL-NET-001.why: All receivers and the link dropped at the same time.
ZL-NET-001.fix: Check the router's uptime and log for that time.

ZL-NET-002.why: The router got a new WAN IP.
ZL-NET-002.fix: Nothing to do: the sender's allowed range was updated.

ZL-NET-003.why: No packets arrived for the TV channel.
ZL-NET-003.fix: Check the router's IGMP / multicast settings and the TTL.

ZL-NET-004.why: Loss started about 125, 260 or 270 s after joining.
ZL-NET-004.fix: Check the router's IGMP querier and snooping settings.

ZL-NET-005.why: The previous TV channel kept coming after leaving.
ZL-NET-005.fix: Check the router's IGMP leave / fast-leave setting.

ZL-NET-006.why: A TV channel that was not asked for arrives.
ZL-NET-006.fix: Check IGMP snooping on the router.

ZL-NET-007.fix: Check the router and cabling for loops; they are counted apart.

ZL-NET-008.fix: Nothing needed if fixed within the window; late ones count as loss.

ZL-NET-009.why: The stream source or sequence changed.
ZL-NET-009.fix: Nothing to do: counted as a new stream, not as loss.

ZL-NET-010.fix: Check the MTU on the path; ZeroLoss packets should never need fragments.

ZL-NET-011.why: The receiver PC's link to the router LAN went down.
ZL-NET-011.fix: Check the LAN cable and port.

ZL-NET-012.what: Link too slow for this test
ZL-NET-012.why: The link speed is below the needed rate × 1.1, or half duplex.
ZL-NET-012.fix: Check or replace the cable and port.

ZL-NET-013.what: Link dropped below the needed speed
ZL-NET-013.why: The link renegotiated to a lower speed during the test.
ZL-NET-013.fix: Check or replace the cable and port.

ZL-NET-014.why: Still enough for this test, but slower than usual — often a cable or port problem.
ZL-NET-014.fix: Check or replace the cable and port.

ZL-NET-015.why: The network link dropped and came back.
ZL-NET-015.fix: Check the cable and port (for Wi-Fi: the router's Wi-Fi and the distance). Nothing to do if it is back up.

ZL-NET-016.why: The router moved its Wi-Fi channel or width (automatic Wi-Fi channel selection, radar/DFS or band steering).
ZL-NET-016.fix: To compare, fix the router's Wi-Fi channel and width, then test again.

ZL-NET-022.what: The test may not go through the router under test
ZL-NET-022.why: The plan names no test network card for this PC, and the Controller reaches it over Wi-Fi (or cannot tell the card), so the video may go around the router.
ZL-NET-022.fix: Register the PC by its test network address (receivers: the router LAN; the sender: the router WAN side), or put nics in the plan. The report says the result is not through the router and a PASS shows as INCOMPLETE.

ZL-SND-025.what: The sender PC sent behind real time
ZL-SND-025.why: The even-spacing sender on the sender PC could not send on time (another program or a driver held the PC), so the stream left it late.
ZL-SND-025.fix: Close what else runs on the sender PC; if its Wi-Fi driver logs resets, turn its Wi-Fi off during tests. Losses then are the sender's, not the router's.

ZL-NET-025.what: The sender PC has Wi-Fi on that the test does not use
ZL-NET-025.why: A Wi-Fi driver on the sender PC that resets can hold up the sending for seconds (2026-10-22: ath9k reset storms, the stream reached the receiver 4.8 s late).
ZL-NET-025.fix: Turn that Wi-Fi off on the sender PC during tests if you want to. ZeroLoss only advises; the test goes on.

ZL-NET-024.what: A card setting the test changed was not put back
ZL-NET-024.why: After its cases the test sets each card back as it was (speed, duplex, Wi-Fi network), and this one did not come back.
ZL-NET-024.fix: Put it back by hand (Auto speed, or its Wi-Fi network), or unplug and plug its cable, then press Fixed, check again in Action Required.

ZL-NET-023.what: Cannot route to the sender PC on the router WAN side
ZL-NET-023.why: This PC's test card has no gateway from the router, or the route could not be added or taken away.
ZL-NET-023.fix: Check that this PC's test card is plugged into the router and got an address. Nothing is changed in the PC's saved settings.

ZL-NET-021.what: A test network card of the plan is not on that PC
ZL-NET-021.why: The plan sends or receives on an address that none of the PC's network cards has, so the test send would fail for another reason.
ZL-NET-021.fix: Check that PC's test card address (on the sender: did the ISP role put 10.0.0.1 on it), or fix nics in the plan.

ZL-NET-020.what: Baseline test needs the sender and receivers on one switch without the router
ZL-NET-020.why: A device is reached through a NAT (the router's WAN address), so the router is still between the sender and the receivers.
ZL-NET-020.fix: Take the router out and plug the sender PC and the receivers into one switch, or set Test network (S-54) to Through the router.

ZL-NET-019.what: The test network card carries this PC's default route
ZL-NET-019.why: The internet of this PC goes into the test network instead of its internet card.
ZL-NET-019.fix: Press Fix in Action Required: the card stops taking the default route and DNS.

ZL-NET-018.what: A test PC is also connected outside the test network
ZL-NET-018.why: The Controller reaches it over Wi-Fi or around the router, or it has an address on another Wi-Fi.
ZL-NET-018.fix: Nothing to do: keep that network on (it may be the PC's internet). The test video still goes through the router on the test card. Never turn the Wi-Fi off or forget the network.

ZL-NET-017.why: The wireless receiver roamed to another BSSID.
ZL-NET-017.fix: Pin the receiver to one access point, or turn roaming off, to compare.

ZL-RCV-001.why: The OS limits the socket buffer size.
ZL-RCV-001.fix: On Linux, set net.core.rmem_max as the installer does, then start again.

ZL-RCV-002.why: The receiving PC could not keep up; this is not the router's fault.
ZL-RCV-002.fix: Close other programs on the receiver PC.

ZL-RCV-003.why: The player process ended; measuring goes on.
ZL-RCV-003.fix: Nothing needed: it restarts (up to 3 times an hour).

ZL-RCV-004.what: Player is part of the test
ZL-RCV-004.fix: Leave the player window open during the test.

ZL-RCV-005.what: This PC cannot decode UHD HEVC fast enough
ZL-RCV-005.why: Hardware decoding is missing or too slow.
ZL-RCV-005.fix: Use HD, or a receiver PC with HEVC hardware decoding.

ZL-RCV-006.what: Screen lock or sleep on the receiver PC
ZL-RCV-006.fix: Turn off screen lock and sleep for the test.

ZL-RCV-007.why: An update may restart the PC during the test.
ZL-RCV-007.fix: Pause updates for the test time.

ZL-RCV-008.what: Disk almost full on the receiver PC
ZL-RCV-008.why: Records need space; below 200 MB the test stops safely.

ZL-RCV-009.why: The disk or folder refused the write.
ZL-RCV-009.fix: Check the disk and folder permissions.

ZL-RCV-010.what: Agent Desktop is not running on the receiver PC
ZL-RCV-010.why: The player needs a logged-in desktop; a test with PC playback on cannot start without it.
ZL-RCV-010.fix: Log in on the receiver PC (turn on auto login for unattended tests), or turn PC playback off (S-49).

ZL-RCV-011.why: The wireless link was lost and came back.
ZL-RCV-011.fix: Check the Wi-Fi signal and the router.

ZL-RCV-012.what: Analyzer uses more CPU than planned
ZL-RCV-012.why: Measuring takes more than its share of this PC.
ZL-RCV-012.fix: Close other programs, or use a faster receiver PC.

ZL-RCV-013.what: External capture tool running — it can load this PC
ZL-RCV-013.why: A capture or analysis program not started by ZeroLoss is running.
ZL-RCV-013.fix: Close it during the test, or accept the marked time range.

ZL-RCV-014.why: The capture dropped packets or ran out of disk; the test goes on.
ZL-RCV-014.fix: Free up disk space or lower the capture size.

ZL-RCV-015.what: Receiver PC may be too slow for playback
ZL-RCV-015.why: Decoding test or CPU headroom is below what this video quality needs; measuring is not affected, only the picture may stutter.
ZL-RCV-015.fix: Use the recommended settings (playback off, small window or HD).

ZL-RCV-016.what: Receiver PC CPU busy — measurement protected
ZL-RCV-016.why: The CPU was over 90% for more than 10 s; measuring was given priority.
ZL-RCV-016.fix: Close other programs; playback problems now are receiver-side.

ZL-RCV-017.why: The group address, network card or permission is wrong.
ZL-RCV-017.fix: Check the receive network card and the TV channel address.

ZL-RCV-018.why: An internal error stopped measuring; data so far is saved.

ZL-RCV-019.fix: Check that the player is installed and that the PC shows a desktop, then press Retry.

ZL-RCV-020.why: The player shows no new frames; measuring goes on.
ZL-RCV-020.fix: Nothing needed first: it is restarted. If it keeps happening, check the receiver PC.

ZL-RCV-021.what: Evidence capture reduced to protect playback
ZL-RCV-021.why: Capturing made playback or measuring worse.
ZL-RCV-021.fix: Nothing needed: capture was reduced automatically.

ZL-RCV-022.what: Stream format differs from the setting
ZL-RCV-022.why: The stream is MPEG-TS over UDP, but Transport (S-10) is RTP, or the other way round.
ZL-RCV-022.fix: Set the sender to RTP, or change Transport (S-10).

ZL-RCV-023.what: The receiver PC is not on the test Wi-Fi
ZL-RCV-023.why: It could not connect to the test Wi-Fi (no Wi-Fi name set, wrong password, network not found or no address).
ZL-RCV-023.fix: Set the test Wi-Fi (zeroloss wifi set) or connect the PC by hand, then press Start again.

ZL-RCV-024.what: Cannot send the prime for the player
ZL-RCV-024.why: The prime for the player must be sent from the player's port with a raw socket, which needs the CAP_NET_RAW right.
ZL-RCV-024.fix: Run the node as the installed service (it has the right), or turn PC playback off (S-49).

ZL-RPT-001.why: The folder is on OneDrive, a network drive, or the service cannot write there.

ZL-RPT-002.why: User names and folders may contain any language.

ZL-RPT-003.fix: Nothing to do: the folder name was shortened.

ZL-RPT-004.what: Part of a record file is damaged
ZL-RPT-004.why: Only the readable part is used; the rest shows grey.
ZL-RPT-004.fix: Check the disk of the device shown.

ZL-RPT-005.why: Some device data was not collected yet (the device did not answer or the file could not be read).
ZL-RPT-005.fix: When the device is back, run 'zeroloss records --run <run>' to fetch the rest.

ZL-RPT-006.fix: Nothing to do: hourly data files are used.

ZL-RPT-007.why: The report could not be opened in a browser.
ZL-RPT-007.fix: Open the report folder instead and open report.html.

ZL-RPT-008.why: The run ID is wrong, the run is not finished, or the report was deleted.
ZL-RPT-008.fix: Check the run ID, or run 'zeroloss status' to see if it is still running.

ZL-RUN-001.why: The 32-bit timestamp restarts about every 13.25 h.

ZL-RUN-003.why: The 33-bit clock restarts about every 26.5 h.
ZL-RUN-003.fix: Nothing to do: handled, not an error.

ZL-RUN-005.why: Times are kept in UTC and elapsed time.

ZL-RUN-006.why: The test is shorter than one 5-min box.
ZL-RUN-006.fix: Nothing to do: it is one partial box, judged with the minimum-data rule.

ZL-RUN-007.what: Settings are locked during the test
ZL-RUN-007.fix: Stop the test first (TV channel change and Snapshot still work).

ZL-RUN-008.what: Planned end and Stop at the same time
ZL-RUN-008.why: Only the one handled first counts.

ZL-RUN-009.why: No stable stream arrived in time (no packets, no PAT/PMT, loss or no picture).
ZL-RUN-009.fix: Check the Problems list for the receiver's reason, then start again.

ZL-RUN-010.why: Joining mid-stream, waiting for the first PAT and early jitter are not errors.

ZL-RUN-011.why: Stopping the sender after the receivers is expected.

ZL-RUN-012.why: It does not fit the current test state.
ZL-RUN-012.fix: Wait for the state shown, then try again.

ZL-RUN-013.why: The feature comes in a later build.
ZL-RUN-013.fix: Use the settings this build supports.

ZL-RUN-014.what: A plan value is outside the allowed range
ZL-RUN-014.why: The value does not fit the settings table.
ZL-RUN-014.fix: Change the value shown to an allowed one.

ZL-SND-001.what: Source file missing — using generated video
ZL-SND-001.why: The video file is missing, damaged or cannot be read.
ZL-SND-001.fix: Check the file on the sender PC; the test goes on with generated video.

ZL-SND-002.why: The file uses a codec the prepared-file mode cannot send.
ZL-SND-002.fix: Press Convert to make a supported copy.

ZL-SND-003.what: Source file bitrate is too high
ZL-SND-003.why: The file needs more than the set bitrate.
ZL-SND-003.fix: Convert the file again at the set bitrate.

ZL-SND-004.what: Break at the file loop point
ZL-SND-004.why: Counters and clocks jump back where the file repeats.
ZL-SND-004.fix: Nothing to do: ZeroLoss joins the loop seamlessly. Report it if it keeps showing.

ZL-SND-005.fix: ZeroLoss restarted it once; if it stops again the test stops. Check the sender PC's log.

ZL-SND-006.why: This PC cannot encode in real time at this video quality.

ZL-SND-007.why: High CPU load can make sending uneven.
ZL-SND-007.fix: Close other programs on the sender PC.

ZL-SND-008.fix: Check the sender PC's load; the event is recorded.

ZL-SND-009.why: The sender PC's link to the router WAN went down.
ZL-SND-009.fix: Check the WAN cable and port; the test stops if it is not back in 30 s.

ZL-SND-010.what: Sender address is not in the router WAN network
ZL-SND-010.why: The sender PC's IP does not match the router WAN range.
ZL-SND-010.fix: Set the sender PC's IP in the WAN range shown, or use built-in DHCP.

ZL-SND-011.what: Router WAN does not ask for an address
ZL-SND-011.why: Built-in DHCP got no request from the router.
ZL-SND-011.fix: Is the router WAN set to DHCP? Check the WAN cable.

ZL-SND-012.why: A second address service answers on the WAN side.
ZL-SND-012.fix: Remove the other DHCP service from the test network.

ZL-SND-013.what: IP address conflict on the WAN side
ZL-SND-013.why: Another device uses the same address.
ZL-SND-013.fix: Remove the device with the MAC shown, or change the address.

ZL-SND-014.why: ZeroLoss could not put the network card back as it was.
ZL-SND-014.fix: Restore the settings by hand as shown.

ZL-SND-015.why: Sending without a Controller would leave traffic nobody watches.
ZL-SND-015.fix: Reconnect the Controller, then start the broadcast again.

ZL-SND-016.why: Nothing was sent for at least 1 s, or the sender card dropped packets.
ZL-SND-016.fix: Check the sender PC (CPU, disk, other programs).

ZL-SND-017.why: The rate was more than 1% low, or gaps of 50 ms or more.
ZL-SND-017.fix: Check the sender PC's load and link.

ZL-SND-018.why: The sender service is alive but does not answer.
ZL-SND-018.fix: ZeroLoss restarts it; check the sender PC if it happens again.

ZL-SND-019.what: Sending did not reach the set rate
ZL-SND-019.why: The sender did not hold the rate within ±1% for 3 s after start.
ZL-SND-019.fix: Check the sender PC and its link, then start again.

ZL-SND-020.what: Could not prepare a TV channel video
ZL-SND-020.why: ffmpeg failed, made no progress for 60 s, the file failed its check, or the disk is too full.
ZL-SND-020.fix: Check the sender PC (free disk space, ffmpeg), then start again.

ZL-SND-021.why: In primed mode the sender sends only where the receiver's prime comes from; none came, it stopped, or its address changed (router NAT restarted or expired).
ZL-SND-021.fix: Check the receiver PC and that the router is in NAT mode; the flow restarts by itself when primes come back.

ZL-SND-024.what: Another device holds 10.0.0.100 on the sender PC's ISP card
ZL-SND-024.why: The device that has the router WAN address still answers on that card, so the device now asking gets no address (two devices must never share it).
ZL-SND-024.fix: Connect only one device to the sender PC's ISP card: the router WAN port, or the receiver PC for a baseline run. The address moves by itself within 10 s after the other device is gone.

ZL-SND-023.what: The sender PC's router WAN address was taken off by another program
ZL-SND-023.why: Another program on the sender PC (often the card's own NetworkManager profile retrying DHCP) removed 10.0.0.1, so the router WAN could not reach the sender PC.
ZL-SND-023.fix: Stop that program from managing the card: nmcli connection modify '<profile on the card>' connection.autoconnect no. Then turn the ISP role on again.

ZL-SND-022.what: The sender PC is not on the router WAN port yet
ZL-SND-022.why: No PC answers from the router WAN side, or the sender PC's wired card still has a router LAN address.
ZL-SND-022.fix: Move the sender PC cable from a router LAN port to the WAN port.

ZL-SYS-001.why: The PC shown is running out of memory.
ZL-SYS-001.fix: Close the programs listed on that PC.

ZL-SYS-002.why: ZeroLoss uses more memory over time than it should.
ZL-SYS-002.fix: Send the logs (this is a ZeroLoss fault).

ZL-SYS-004.why: Memory, disk or CPU is below what the test needs.
ZL-SYS-004.fix: Free the resources shown, then start again.

ZL-SYS-005.what: Could not pause updates or sleep
ZL-SYS-005.why: Updates or sleep may restart or stop a PC during the test.
ZL-SYS-005.fix: Pause updates and turn off sleep on the PC shown (How to fix).

ZL-SYS-006.why: It kept running after the forced stop.

ZL-SYS-007.why: A program from an earlier run was still running.
ZL-SYS-007.fix: Nothing to do: it was stopped.

ZL-SYS-008.why: A part of ZeroLoss that handles events failed; the rest goes on.

ZL-SYS-009.what: Service was not answering and was restarted
ZL-SYS-009.why: The node service did not answer for 10 s; the Deployer restarted it.
ZL-SYS-009.fix: If it happens again, press Export diagnostics and send the file.

ZL-SYS-010.why: Less than 20% or 50 GB is free where this PC keeps its results. Nothing is deleted by itself.
ZL-SYS-010.fix: Press Storage and delete old runs or only their raw data.

ZL-SYS-012.what: The PC's automatic time sync was not held during the test, or not turned back on
ZL-SYS-012.why: A clock corrected during a test (NTP) moves arrival times, which can look like delay variation.
ZL-SYS-012.fix: By hand on that Linux PC: before the test sudo timedatectl set-ntp false, after it sudo timedatectl set-ntp true. The test goes on either way.

ZL-SYS-011.what: A settings file could not be read
ZL-SYS-011.why: The file was damaged (power loss or disk error). It was kept aside and ZeroLoss started without it.
ZL-SYS-011.fix: Add the devices again (Find devices or 'zeroloss discover'); send the kept file if it happens again.

ZL-TAB-001.why: The cable came out or the port reset; the tablet keeps measuring and saving.
ZL-TAB-001.fix: Plug the USB cable back in; data is collected when it reconnects.

ZL-TAB-002.what: adb restarted or another adb is running
ZL-TAB-002.why: Another program started a different adb.
ZL-TAB-002.fix: Close the program shown; ZeroLoss reconnects with its own adb.

ZL-TAB-003.what: Tablet app was closed by the system
ZL-TAB-003.why: Android stopped the app in the background.
ZL-TAB-003.fix: Nothing needed: it is restarted. Exclude the app from battery optimization.

ZL-TAB-004.why: The app ended unexpectedly; its log was collected.

ZL-TAB-005.why: The tablet left the test Wi-Fi or joined another network.
ZL-TAB-005.fix: Connect the tablet to the test Wi-Fi shown.

ZL-TAB-006.why: The tablet got a new IP (DHCP renewal).
ZL-TAB-006.fix: Nothing to do: the tablet joined again.

ZL-TAB-007.why: Low battery or heat slows the tablet down.
ZL-TAB-007.fix: Connect the charger and keep the tablet cool.

ZL-TAB-008.what: A system popup covers the player
ZL-TAB-008.why: An update or other notice came to the front.
ZL-TAB-008.fix: Nothing needed: the app is brought back. Turn off such notices for the test.

ZL-TAB-009.why: The screen layout changed; playing and measuring go on.

ZL-TAB-010.why: A restarted tablet does not resume the old test.
ZL-TAB-010.fix: Start a new test when ready.

ZL-TAB-011.why: Records need space; the test stops safely when it runs out.
ZL-TAB-011.fix: Free up space on the tablet.

ZL-TAB-012.what: Other Wi-Fi traffic on the tablet
ZL-TAB-012.why: Apps other than ZeroLoss use the Wi-Fi.
ZL-TAB-012.fix: Close or turn off the app shown.

ZL-TAB-013.why: Android released the multicast or low-latency lock.
ZL-TAB-013.fix: Nothing needed: it was taken again.

ZL-TAB-014.what: Tablet not on the test Wi-Fi
ZL-TAB-014.why: Automatic connection failed (password, SSID, Android version or device policy).
ZL-TAB-014.fix: Connect the tablet to the test Wi-Fi by hand; ZeroLoss sees it and goes on.

ZL-TAB-015.what: Player did not start on the tablet
ZL-TAB-015.why: No first picture while the app is measuring.
ZL-TAB-015.fix: Unlock the tablet and bring the ZeroLoss app to the front, then press Retry.

ZL-TAB-016.why: The screen is off or covered, or the player stopped; measuring goes on.
ZL-TAB-016.fix: Turn the screen on and keep the ZeroLoss app in front.

ZL-TIM-001.what: PC clock changed during the test
ZL-TIM-001.why: Intervals use a steady clock and are not affected.

ZL-USR-002.why: The value has the wrong format or is out of range.
ZL-USR-002.fix: Enter a value as shown in the help.

ZL-USR-004.what: Router settings changed during the test
ZL-USR-004.why: Changing the router mid-test mixes results.
ZL-USR-004.fix: Note the change; test again for a clean result.

ZL-USR-005.fix: Run the installer again; it cleans up first.

ZL-USR-006.what: Start cancelled while videos were being made
ZL-USR-006.why: Cancel was pressed during video preparation.
ZL-USR-006.fix: Press Start again; videos already made are kept.

ZL-USR-007.why: Someone stopped the test on that PC itself (zeroloss agent stop).
ZL-USR-007.fix: Start the test again from the Controller when the PC is ready.

ZL-TAB-017.what: A tablet could not be handled
ZL-TAB-017.why: An adb command for this tablet failed (install, start or stop the app, or the forward to it); adb's own words are shown.
ZL-TAB-017.fix: Do what the line says for this tablet (allow USB debugging, plug its cable in again, or Update PCs), then press the button again. Other tablets are not touched.

ZL-TAB-018.what: A tablet scans for Wi-Fi by itself on a timer
ZL-TAB-018.why: An app on the tablet (e.g. Samsung Context Engine) makes the Wi-Fi leave the channel for seconds every 30 minutes; the live stream meanwhile is lost. The router is not the cause.
ZL-TAB-018.fix: The tool pauses that app during the test and puts it back after. If it could not, the test goes on; Reset All tries to put it back again.
